instruction: An overhead aerial photograph captures a group of people lying on a green lawn. In a wide high-angle drone shot looking straight down, several people lie on the grass in a circle, holding hands, though some individuals are digitally blurred. Among the visible people, the man in the white shirt and beige shorts (R3) lies at the top, smiling up. To his right, the man in the yellow shirt and pink shorts (R1) lies with arms outstretched and eyes closed. On the left, the woman in the green tank top and white pants (R2) wears a straw hat and smiles. Several other young adults lie in the circle, with some individuals on the right and bottom heavily blurred. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight, highlighting the vibrant green grass and colorful outfits.
